WITH store_pivot AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS store_1998,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS store_1999
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
store_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer_sk, store_1998, store_1999
    FROM store_pivot
    WHERE store_1998 > 0 AND store_1999 IS NOT NULL
),
web_pivot AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1998 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS web_1998,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS web_1999
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_candidates sc ON sc.customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT sc.customer_sk, sc.store_1998, sc.store_1999, wp.web_1998, wp.web_1999
    FROM store_candidates sc
    JOIN web_pivot wp ON wp.customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
    WHERE wp.web_1998 > 0 AND wp.web_1999 IS NOT NULL
      AND wp.web_1999 * sc.store_1998 > sc.store_1999 * wp.web_1998
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
       c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
       c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM final_candidates fc
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = fc.customer_sk
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_email_address
LIMIT 100
